## TransferStore.allocateTemporaryCopy() method

Mint a temporary copy for a local read by `subject`<!-- -->: the store creates an empty file at a fresh path of its own choosing and records it. The caller writes the copy's bytes there and releases it when done; the sweep removes it after its lifetime. The store never accepts a caller-chosen path, so it can only ever delete files it named.

**Signature:**

```typescript
allocateTemporaryCopy(subject: string, options?: AllocateTemporaryCopyOptions): Promise<AllocatedTemporaryCopy>;
```
